name: issue_1048_sensi_like_off_thermostat_must_switch_to_heat
description: Issue #1048: a Sensi-like thermostat (ignores the hvac_mode kwarg of climate.set_temperature and rejects set_temperature while Off) is Off on a cold morning with indoor below the comfort floor. Climate Advisor must explicitly switch the thermostat to heat (climate.set_hvac_mode) before/with the floor setpoint. On HEAD, CA only embeds hvac_mode in set_temperature, so the quirk drops the call and the thermostat stays Off while CA logs 'comfort band applied'.
source: Issue #1048 (devrsw, Sensi, Celsius): 102 of 103 'house too cold' alerts had the thermostat Off; heating never turned on.
notes: (a) Scenario effectiveness: this scenario FAILS on HEAD (thermostat remains 'off') and passes once CA issues a real set_hvac_mode(heat). If the explicit mode switch were deleted from production it would fail again, because the sensi_like quirk drops the mode embedded in set_temperature.
(b) Docs<->production alignment: docs/sim-harness-spec.md documents the opt-in sensi_like quirk; the production write-point contract is in docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md.
(c) Occupant experience: the house sits 1-3 degrees below the comfort floor for days with zero heating while the Activity Log says 'heat applied'.
classification hvac_mode='heat' and windows_recommended=false match DayClassification._compute_recommendations() for day_type 'cold'.

events.note: Thermostat is Off, indoor 64F is 6F below comfort_heat (70F).
Cold day: the comfort band arms with the floor edge active, so CA must command heat.

assertions.reason: The thermostat itself (not CA's command log) must end up in heat: a Sensi-like device ignores hvac_mode inside set_temperature, so only an explicit climate.set_hvac_mode(heat) can turn heating on.

verdict.summary: Reproduces issue #1048: CA never switches a Sensi-like Off thermostat on, so the house stays cold.
verdict.observed_behavior: On HEAD the thermostat stays 'off': set_temperature(hvac_mode=heat) is ignored/rejected by the quirk and CA never calls set_hvac_mode.
verdict.expected_behavior: CA issues climate.set_hvac_mode(heat) and the thermostat ends in heat.
